Usage: find [-H] [-L] [-P] [-Olevel] [-D debugopts] [path...] [expression]

default path is the current directory;  default expression is -print
expression may consist of:  operators (decreasing precedence; -a is implicit), options, tests, and actions:

operators (decreasing precedence; -a is implicit):
     ( EXPR )       ! EXPR        -not EXPR          EXPR1 -a EXPR2
     EXPR1 -o EXPR2              EXPR1 , EXPR2

positional options (always true):
     -daystart -follow -regextype -warn

normal options (always true, specified before expression):
     -depth -maxdepth LEVELS -mindepth LEVELS -mount -noleaf --version
     -help

tests (N can be +N or -N or N):
     -amin N -anewer FILE -atime N -cmin N
     -cnewer FILE -ctime N -empty -false -fstype TYPE -gid N
     -group NAME -ilname PATTERN -iname PATTERN -inum N

actions:
     -delete -print0 -fprintf FILE FORMAT -print -fprint0 FILE -fprint FILE
     -ls -fls FILE -prune -quit -exec COMMAND ; -exec COMMAND {} +
